# SYNESIS_E084 — Error

## Description

`INCLUDE SHARED` invalid for ANNOTATIONS — only ONTOLOGY accepts SHARED.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
`INCLUDE SHARED` is only valid for `ONTOLOGY`, but it was used with
  `ANNOTATIONS` (`path`).
  The word `SHARED` allows a target OUTSIDE the project folder — it exists
  to share the conceptual vocabulary (the organizing model) between projects
  of the same study. The other includes must stay inside the project.
  Remove `SHARED`, or move the file into the project folder.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **SharedOnlyForOntology**: `include_type`, `path`
